role: typed agent completion, strict event ownership, artifact capture, durable downstream acceptance, and terminal routing
phase_order: validate and merge the private one-shot launch context before loading config or completion modules
resolve the exact run, agent, attempt, event root, and strict declared event
capture completion evidence and reduce it to one typed verdict and executor plan
bind every replayable synchronous operation to the accepted completion occurrence and stable idempotency key
persist locked local state and queue idempotent external effects
start every routed or fan-out target and durably accept its run agent, session, and AgentAttempt state
commit any fan-in claim only after target acceptance
consume the explicit trigger and archive only owned events after effects and targets are accepted
remove the completed agent and monitor sessions or persist retryable cleanup evidence

event_matching.format: strict canonical .event file with event, source, run_id, timestamp, processed, and data exactly once plus validated lowercase extension fields
event_matching.ownership: agent or session identity with the full chain agent-id set guarding prefix-sharing siblings
event_matching.invalid_file_policy: fail closed; JSON, aliases, noncanonical casing, missing or duplicate fields, and filename-derived ownership never satisfy completion
event_matching.declared_emits_missing: fail the agent/run, emit only a diagnostic agent-error, and launch no downstream route; compatible core-generation artifacts are the sole typed no-emit completion exception
event_matching.legacy_diagnostic_source: the chain-runner-complete source label remains parser-only compatibility for pre-cutover diagnostic files

event_consumption.implementation: web/lib/runner-v2/event-lifecycle.ts consumeRunnerEvents under one filesystem claim
event_consumption.triggered_event: must be a direct strict .event child of the configured EVENTS_DIR; planning captures its exact pre-launch file-generation token plus raw and normalized hashes, launches and synchronous effects must accept first, owned-sibling cleanup runs next, and processed trigger bytes plus its version-2 receipt are claimed before unchanged active source bytes are unlinked last
event_consumption.retry_proof: completion discovery scans active files only; missing-source consume requires a receipt matching the exact pre-launch file-generation token and accepted raw/normalized hashes, then validates its strict processed archive destination, archived hash, run_id, owner, and event; an already-archived replay returns immediately without scanning later live same-run/owner files
event_consumption.owned_events: archive only strict records with the same exact nonempty run_id and guarded agent/session ownership
event_consumption.survivors: sibling-agent, other-run, runless-ingress, and invalid files remain active

routing.dedupe: the pre-launch file-generation token is folded into routed-launch and completion-effect occurrence identity; skip a target only for current durably accepted state from that exact occurrence, while a byte-identical recreated file is a new occurrence
routing.loop_guard: repeat current-agent:event pair completes the run

synchronous_operations.identity: the executor carries the accepted completion occurrence into the adapter context; event emission, schedule history, hook dispatch, session-policy audit, and rollback audit fail closed without it and derive a stable per-operation idempotency key
synchronous_operations.claims: schedule state/history, hook dispatch, session-policy audit, rollback audit, and the completion-event emission receipt are serialized by owner-bearing typed file claims
synchronous_operations.event_emission: canonical event-emitter writes never clobber different bytes; same occurrence dedupes by stable key, later occurrences use collision-safe distinct files, and completion-event-emissions.jsonl suppresses replay after the emitted event moves to archive
synchronous_operations.hook_delivery: a dispatched receipt suppresses ordinary completion replay; executable hooks receive MENTIKO_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY and MENTIKO_COMPLETION_OCCURRENCE_ID plus the same values in details. A process crash after spawn but before the dispatched receipt is explicitly at-least-once and requires hook-side dedupe for exactly-once behavior
synchronous_operations.local_audits: schedule, session-policy, and rollback ledgers store the stable operation key and append once per occurrence; schedule replay repairs state.json from the original receipt timestamp

invariants: never fabricate the declared emits event
diagnostic events never satisfy success handoff matching
a missing agent summary stubs as status unknown; an all-stub completed run resolves needs_review with decision_required, never complete (0c96b73)
archive only events owned by run id plus source or agent
quality gates run before generation import and downstream routing
fan-in claim commits only after the typed target launch is durably accepted; rejection leaves the claim retryable
typed routed and fan-out launches wait synchronously for bounded CLI exit plus durable run agent, session, and AgentAttempt proof before consuming the parent event
a later operation failure cannot duplicate already accepted synchronous work when the same completion occurrence replays
task status propagation happens on completed, failed, and stopped
